scope: Grouped-indicator model/quotient correspondence, explicit-list regularity and one source-qualified solving-degree upper bound
elliptic_scope: p>max(3,s), s>=2, nonzero original bit weights, nonsingular short Weierstrass curve, finite rational target with nonzero ordinate

claims.models: explicit bit/indicator bijection and isomorphic affine quotients; not equal ideals in different rings
claims.raw_even_s3_exact: d_reg(Fg)=s+1 for even s>=2, with 3s variables and 6s local quadratics
claims.mutant_closure_upper: sd_sigma(Fg)<=s+2 for degree-compatible order, under Salizzoni Definition2.5/Proposition3.10

cost_limits: Fixed-width local construction is linear, but expanding the substituted quartic can require O(N^4) terms.
Growing group width incurs exponential indicators and pairwise constraints.
Pair-group local quotient dimension is 4^s; no combinatorial state reduction is claimed.
No degree-bound transfer to new circuit auxiliary variables without separate proof.
No strict comparison of actual solving degrees or measured solver costs.
excluded_scope: generic exact-threshold observation outside the frozen grouped target
